Among the five regulars there are 1 killer, 2 informants (who know something extra about the investigation) and 2 neutrals. Anyone can negotiate for a cigarette or physical clue and share a personal secret; only informants have an extra statement. Only the killer lies about where someone was — exactly one structured lie.

Streetlights go out sector by sector. In darkness, clues vanish, people move unseen and sanity drops. Drizzle erases footprints. When the last light goes out, the killer attacks.

How to win: tap ACCUSE NOW in the square or ACCUSE in conversation, choose any suspect and confirm. Correct accusation wins. First error: −25 SAN, another sector darkens, an innocent stops cooperating and the killer hides. Second error: defeat. No evidence required. The BOARD is optional: compare statements and clues to support your decision or use the investigative confrontation.

Lu: tell her what an informant said — she compares only shared notes. Use DISCUSS HYPOTHESES and REVIEW INVESTIGATION. Pressuring her about the case costs trust.

messages.ui.friday_november_20_2026_21_43_fine_dr:
Friday, November 20, 2026. 21:43. Fine drizzle in Praça Coronel Pedro Osório, downtown Pelotas, Brazil.

A new case awaits each game. The LIBRARY lets you select stories or create new ones with AI. Tonight someone here is hiding what happened — and the square's power grid is collapsing.

You are Cláudio. With Christopher and Lu, cross-check testimony and clues before the last streetlight goes out.

How to win: tap ACCUSE NOW at any time, choose a suspect and confirm. If correct, you win. The first mistake has serious consequences; the second ends the game. Use FREE CONVERSATION to build trust and negotiate information; traditional questions remain quick. Listen to nearby regulars and share notes with Lu to discuss hypotheses. Regulars form impressions, change strategies and react to pressure; personal opinion is not proof. Social dynamics evolve as the clock advances, even when you're not talking. The diary and confrontation with evidence are optional. Investigate to increase certainty.

Each case is generated and validated by an investigation and confrontation simulation.
